selection_note: Curated tooling/integration specialists; use alongside the existing Isometric interaction skills. No runtime dependencies are installed.

skills.name: ztx14-curated-isometric-component-selection
skills.title: Choose the smallest correct Isometric component
skills.description: Select the smallest relevant Isometric registry item and use its documented interaction contract before implementing isometric UI.

skills.name: ztx14-curated-animation-ownership-boundary
skills.title: Keep one owner for every animated property
skills.description: Prevent conflicting animation engines by assigning each animated SVG/DOM property and state transition to one owner.

skills.name: ztx14-curated-motion-react-pointer-spring
skills.title: React pointer-follow with Motion values and springs
skills.description: Build lightweight pointer-follow, magnetic, tilt, and cursor-responsive DOM motion with Motion for React without rerendering on every pointer move.

skills.name: ztx14-curated-motion-hover-cross-device
skills.title: Cross-device hover without sticky touch states
skills.description: Implement hover affordances with Motion’s gesture recognition or CSS capability queries so touch interactions do not remain in a fake hover state.

skills.name: ztx14-curated-gsap-responsive-scroll
skills.title: GSAP scroll choreography with responsive cleanup
skills.description: Use GSAP timelines and ScrollTrigger for complex coordinated scroll storytelling, with breakpoint-specific setup that is reverted cleanly.

skills.name: ztx14-curated-css-scroll-timelines
skills.title: Progressive enhancement with native CSS scroll timelines
skills.description: Prefer native CSS scroll-driven animation for simple progress-linked effects, with a safe fallback for unsupported or reduced-motion environments.

skills.name: ztx14-curated-lenis-adoption-gate
skills.title: Use Lenis only when native scrolling is insufficient
skills.description: Evaluate Lenis for intentional smooth scrolling and scroll-synchronized storytelling without degrading native accessibility or mobile behavior.

skills.name: ztx14-curated-svg-pointer-hit-testing
skills.title: Reliable pointer picking for SVG and isometric figures
skills.description: Debug SVG and projected-geometry hit testing by separating visible outlines from semantic interaction hit regions.

skills.name: ztx14-curated-pointer-capture-drag
skills.title: Robust drag interactions with Pointer Capture
skills.description: Implement drag and gesture interactions that survive leaving the target, handle cancellation, and share behavior across mouse, pen and touch.

skills.name: ztx14-curated-responsive-motion-capabilities
skills.title: Adapt motion to viewport and input capabilities
skills.description: Scale interaction intensity using the container size, pointer capability, reduced-motion preference, orientation and device performance.

skills.name: ztx14-curated-reduced-motion-system
skills.title: Systemic reduced-motion behavior across every engine
skills.description: Apply the user motion preference consistently across CSS, Motion, GSAP, Isometric and embedded animation players.

skills.name: ztx14-curated-react-animation-lifecycle
skills.title: React lifecycle safety for animation and browser listeners
skills.description: Make imperative animation setup resilient to React Strict Mode, remounts, dependency changes, and hot reload by implementing symmetric cleanup.

skills.name: ztx14-curated-shared-loop-offscreen-sleep
skills.title: Preserve one frame loop and sleep when motion is idle
skills.description: Prevent wasteful perpetual animation loops and coordinate offscreen/idle rendering with the existing Isometric engine.

skills.name: ztx14-curated-css-motion-performance
skills.title: Keep UI animation on compositor-friendly properties
skills.description: Review CSS and DOM animation costs to avoid layout thrash, paint-heavy effects, and excessive GPU layers.

skills.name: ztx14-curated-shadcn-registry-safe-install
skills.title: Install Isometric items without overwriting project setup
skills.description: Use the shadcn registry CLI safely, preserve existing components.json settings, and verify the exact installed files and dependencies.

skills.name: ztx14-curated-tailwind-v4-isometric-tokens
skills.title: Integrate Tailwind v4 and Isometric tokens cleanly
skills.description: Adapt Isometric colors and depth styling to the current shadcn/Tailwind v4 theme without global leakage or token collisions.

skills.name: ztx14-curated-keyboard-parity-radix
skills.title: Preserve keyboard and screen-reader behavior in isometric controls
skills.description: Audit isometric primitives and custom figures so hover and pointer behavior has a complete keyboard, focus and semantic counterpart.

skills.name: ztx14-curated-playwright-pointer-e2e
skills.title: Automate realistic pointer and drag journeys with Playwright
skills.description: Create browser-level regression tests for pointer hover, dragging, touch-like input, focus, responsive behavior, and cancellation.

skills.name: ztx14-curated-playwright-visual-baselines
skills.title: Make animation screenshots deterministic before visual comparison
skills.description: Use Playwright screenshot snapshots to catch layout and motion regressions while controlling time, hover state, fonts, viewport and browser variance.

skills.name: ztx14-curated-vitest-browser-interactions
skills.title: Use Vitest Browser Mode for component-level interaction coverage
skills.description: Test real browser DOM behavior of React interaction components using Vitest Browser Mode and a supported browser provider.

skills.name: ztx14-curated-storybook-interaction-a11y
skills.title: Use Storybook as an interactive component lab
skills.description: Create reproducible component stories and automate interactions and accessibility checks for isometric UI pieces.

skills.name: ztx14-curated-react-three-fiber-adoption-gate
skills.title: Adopt React Three Fiber only for actual 3D scenes
skills.description: Decide whether a feature needs WebGL/real 3D before introducing Three.js and React Three Fiber into a primarily SVG isometric project.

skills.name: ztx14-curated-rive-lottie-decision
skills.title: Choose Rive or Lottie by interaction model
skills.description: Select Rive state machines or Lottie playback for authored vector animation, without replacing procedural isometric geometry unnecessarily.

skills.name: ztx14-curated-resizeobserver-container-adaptation
skills.title: Adapt isometric layout to its container, not just the viewport
skills.description: Use ResizeObserver carefully when a component's geometry and hit testing depend on its own container dimensions.

skills.name: ztx14-curated-world-pan-zoom-coordinate-stability
skills.title: Keep pan and zoom anchored and input-safe in the Isometric World
skills.description: Implement or review world pan/zoom without coordinate drift, accidental page gestures, or broken selection after scaling.

skills.name: ztx14-curated-animation-debug-signoff
skills.title: Debug animation through state traces, not guesswork
skills.description: Troubleshoot jitter, stuck hover, frame drops, disappearing SVG faces, or inconsistent animation using a reproducible trace and evidence-based sign-off.

skills.name: ztx14-curated-animation-performance-budget
skills.title: Set a budget for frames, geometry and event work
skills.description: Prevent interaction complexity from scaling into frame drops by setting measurable budgets and degradation paths.

skills.name: ztx14-curated-agent-research-version-gate
skills.title: Ground implementation in current installed APIs
skills.description: Require agents to inspect official current docs and local package versions before using animation or registry APIs.

skills.name: ztx14-curated-license-and-provenance-gate
skills.title: Audit dependency license and source provenance before adding tooling
skills.description: Check licenses, provenance, dependency impact and vendor policy before copying code or adding an animation runtime.

skills.name: ztx14-curated-state-transition-motion-presence
skills.title: Animate state transitions without making state animation-dependent
skills.description: Coordinate enter/exit and presence transitions so components remain correct when state changes rapidly or routes unmount.
